title: EspoCRM before 9.3.11 and 10.x before 10.0.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability in which the…
description: EspoCRM versions before 9.3.11 and 10.x before 10.0.8 contain a denial of service vulnerability due to a CPU-intensive password-redaction regular expression in API error handling. Unauthenticated remote attackers can exploit this by sending a few large API requests concurrently, exhausting server resources and causing service slowdowns or unavailability.
